text:
deepa: Heads up — onboarding Zephyrus11B (open checkpoint) with int4 quant produced a reproducible summary-quality regression on our news-summarization eval. Perf looks fine but outputs truncate and hallucinate dates.
aj: can you paste the eval snippet + config?
deepa: here — config: `quant: int4, backend: fastkern, rotary_scale: 1.0 (default)`, tokenizer: SentencePiece v3, model converted with our `convert-zephyrus` script. Eval snippet: ```src: 'article about city council' ref: 'Council approved budget on Tue.' pred: 'On Monday the council... 2028'```
dan: oof, hallucinated year jump. Did conversion remap sentinel/EOS ids?
deepa: I ran quick checks — vocab map preserved, EOS id 2 both sides. But KV cache logs show negative offset warnings during warmup: `kvcache: head0 offset -1 applied -> wrapped`
triage-bot: added tag `regression/quality` and `triage:needs-repro`
maria: could be rotary frequency mismatch — Zephyrus uses headwise rotary scale of 0.98 in upstream weights. If we use 1.0 during runtime probability mass can shift in long-context which affects summarization.
aj: nice catch. Is that encoded in model metadata?
deepa: upstream repo had `rotary_freq_scale: 0.98` in pytorch state_dict meta but our converter ignored it. I missed it.
dan: how noisy is the repro? single seed?
deepa: deterministic eval with fixed seed: failure rate ~85% on the failing prompt set. I ran with and without cache warmup; warmup reduces raw latency but still fails.
maria: try rerunning with runtime override `--rotary-scale 0.98` and disable kv cache warmup to see if it changes.
ml-ci-bot: queued job #zephyrus-int4-rotary-repro (canary)
aj: also add a tokenizer sanity check: run `token_ids = sp.encode(text)` and compare hashes across checkpoints to ensure no invisible normalization differences.
deepa: running now. will post logs.
(10m later)
deepa: Quick update: override `--rotary-scale 0.98` + disable warmup -> failure rate drops to 12%, outputs line up with reference more often. Tokenizer hashes matched. So two things: converter dropped rotary_scale meta, and warmup combined with int4 nonlinearity amplifies phase drift.
dan: great repro. Plan: 1) patch converter to carry rotary meta through; 2) add converter unit test that asserts `rotary_scale` preserved; 3) short-term: apply runtime fallback to read `rotary_scale` from model metadata and apply by default.
aj: add an eval in canary pipeline to guard summary QA (fail if ROUGE-L drops >4 points).
maria: also add an optional kvcache-stable warmup mode that preloads but doesn't apply offset corrections (we want deterministic).
deepa: I'll open a PR for converter + unit tests and a follow-up for runtime fallback. Will attach failing example and CI job id.
ml-ci-bot: job #zephyrus-int4-rotary-repro finished: 1 failed, 4 passed (canary). Logs: `/ci/jobs/6110002222/zephyrus-int4-rotary-repro.log`
aj: ping me on the PR; if you want I can help with the runtime flag.
deepa: thanks — sending PR in ~30m. adding reproduction prompt and minimal script: ```python
# repro script
load_model('zephyrus-int4')
set_runtime(rotary_scale=0.98, kv_warmup=False)
run_eval('summaries/failing_set.json')
```
dan: perfect. once PR lands, we should run full qual sweep (summaries, qa, chat) to catch any other side-effects.
maria: agree — and add a lightweight integration test: convert -> run canonical prompt -> hash output to detect regressions earlier.
deepa: noted. creating issues and linking to regression board. :white_check_mark:
